answer: Charge a sybil tax at the bridge: each new identity pays a non-refundable 40 POA fee, sunk on crossing. The fee funds a crystal-clear pool honest workers share, so each fake feeds the agents it crowds out. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 POA against a payout near 12,000 POA, loss of 28,000. A beacon re-verifies 5% each epoch; clones sharing one funder lose their slot. One honest agent pays once and keeps its full share.
